caption: A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
relations: The ruler's straight shape deforms as force is applied at both ends, causing internal stress to build along its length.
The material resists bending until the stress exceeds its strength, leading to a visible crack forming at the point of highest strain.
The crack propagates rapidly through the ruler's body as the applied force continues, splitting the plastic along a fracture path.
The ruler remains under tension until the fracture completes, leaving two separated pieces with jagged edges.
